name: Repo-scoped Onboarding Tour refuses to generate on an unindexed repo
description: Reaches /repos/<id>/onboarding through the sidebar row (the repo id comes from the home redirect, never hardcoded) and confirms the state a newcomer actually hits first: the seeded demo repo has no repo_index_state row, so the server answers generate_blocked=index_missing and the page must name that reason and offer nothing to press (SPEC-03 AC-63, AC-83). The refusal sentence is asserted whole rather than by keyword: AC-84 forbids copy that claims indexing is under way or that waiting helps, and a rewrite that reintroduced one could not leave this string intact. Zero model calls — the read is cached and its container has no llm port, and nothing here presses Generate. Distinct from 06-onboarding.flow.json, which guards the unrelated /onboarding add-repository screen (AC-8); the pathname is pinned with startsWith('/repos/') rather than a bare substring, so the two flows can never satisfy each other's assertions.

steps.label: root redirects to the seeded repo (this is where the repo id comes from)
the sidebar row exists before it is clicked (the URL settling does not imply the repo list has)
follow the sidebar row to the tour
the repo-scoped tour route is reached, not the bare /onboarding screen
the heading names the seeded repository

cmd: A tour is written from an index of the repository, and there is no finished one here. Index the repository, then generate the tour.
